title: Wyoming Statutes, Title 9 - Administration of the Government, Chapter 3 - Compensation and Benefits, Article 4 - Retirement
source_id: Wyo. Stat. Ann. tit. 9, ch. 3, art. 4 (ss 9-3-401 through 9-3-454)
verified_how: walked the LSO NXT table of contents (gateway.dll?f=xmlcontents&command=getchildren) down to 'TITLE 9 - ADMINISTRATION OF THE GOVERNMENT' > 'CHAPTER 3 - COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS' > 'ARTICLE 4 - RETIREMENT', running from '9-3-401. Short title.' and '9-3-402. Definitions.' to '9-3-454. Required determinations for recommended benefit increases.'. Repealed sections are shown in the same listing with a 'Repealed by Laws ...' catchline (e.g. '37-3-103. Repealed by Laws 1995, ch. 192, s 3.'), so the substantive catchlines above are live text. Currency: the LSO's Statutes Download page states 'This version of the Wyoming Statutes contains changes from the 2026 Budget Session and reflects the contents of the statutes as they exist as of July 1, 2026'; the NXT infobase I browsed is the one labelled '2026 Wyoming Statutes' (the register also keeps 2020-2025 as separate historical infobases). Official title PDF at https://wyoleg.gov/statutes/compress/title09.pdf.
notes: This is the Wyoming Retirement Act (the Wyoming Retirement System, covering state and participating local government employees). The register's contents tree shows the catchline 's 9-3-401. Short title.' but not the short title's own words, so the Act's name is not quoted here from the register - confirm it when the text is read. Sibling articles in the same chapter, not encoded: art. 3 Social Security (the state's agreement with the federal system), art. 5 Deferred Compensation Program, art. 6 State Highway Patrol, Game (and wardens) retirement, art. 7 Judicial Retirement. Federal Social Security (42 U.S.C. ch. 7) and private pensions (ERISA) are federal.
